# NI Bin Guy

> NI Bin Guy is a professional domestic and commercial wheelie bin cleaning service based in Bangor, County Down, Northern Ireland. We clean, sanitise and deodorise bins for homes and businesses across our established local service areas.

## Core Services

- Regular domestic wheelie bin cleaning on a 4-weekly schedule
- One-off domestic wheelie bin cleaning
- Commercial bin cleaning for businesses and organisations
- Cleaning for 120L, 240L, 360L, 660L and 1100L bins
- Wheelie bin washing, sanitising and deodorising
- Removal of dirt, grime and waste residue that can contribute to unpleasant odours and pests

## Commercial Bin Cleaning

NI Bin Guy provides commercial bin cleaning in the towns listed below. Commercial cleaning is available by arrangement for larger business bins and waste containers, including 360L, 660L and 1100L bins.

Commercial customers can include restaurants, takeaways, cafes, pubs, offices, shops, schools, care facilities, apartment developments and other organisations using wheelie bins or larger commercial bins.

Commercial pricing depends on bin size, number of bins, location and required cleaning frequency. Businesses can contact NI Bin Guy for availability and a quote.

## Domestic Bin Cleaning

Regular domestic wheelie bin cleaning starts from GBP 5 per bin. Regular customers are normally serviced on a 4-weekly cleaning schedule. One-off domestic cleans start from GBP 15.

Common household black, blue, brown and green wheelie bins can be cleaned, subject to local availability and collection schedules.

## How The Service Works

For domestic cleaning, bins are normally cleaned after they have been emptied. The bin should be accessible for cleaning. NI Bin Guy washes the bin to remove grime and residue, then sanitises and deodorises it before leaving it ready to use again.

Commercial arrangements can vary according to bin type, premises, number of bins and cleaning frequency.
